ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: glslang: the GLSL front end and SPIR-V generator of the Khronos Group
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: glslang 16.6.0, which compiles GLSL to SPIR-V. It is the shader compiler of the Vulkan render system of Ogre (the plugin OgrePlugin_GLSLangProgramManager). Built: the GLSL front end (glslang/MachineIndependent, GenericCodeGen, OSDependent), the SPIR-V back end (SPIRV) and the default resource limits (glslang/ResourceLimits). Not built: the HLSL front end, the C interfaces, the SPIR-V optimiser (SPIRV-Tools is not part of this code base, so the SPIR-V is not optimised for size), the tools and the tests. Consumers include its headers as glslang/... and SPIRV/..., from the directory of this module.
